empty.title: No screens or windows available
empty.description: OpenScreen could not find any capture sources yet. Retry after your desktop finishes loading or after you reconnect your display.

permissionBlocked.title: Screen Recording access is blocked
permissionBlocked.description: macOS is blocking OpenScreen from listing capture sources. Open System Settings, enable OpenScreen under Screen Recording, then retry.

permissionMissing.title: Screen Recording permission is still missing
permissionMissing.description: OpenScreen needs macOS Screen Recording access before it can list screens and windows. Open System Settings, grant the permission, then retry.

permissionStale.title: Screen Recording permission looks stale
permissionStale.description: macOS says OpenScreen is allowed, but it still returns zero capture sources. This usually happens after upgrading from an older build. Reset the Screen Recording permission, then retry to trigger a fresh macOS prompt.

recording.selectSource: Please select a source to record
